hero.title: Manage Your Shop Orders, Inventory & Customers — All in One Place
hero.subtitle: Levix helps local businesses handle daily operations faster. Take orders via WhatsApp, track stock, manage customers, and run your shop without complexity.
features.title: Everything Your Shop Needs
features.sub: From taking orders to tracking inventory — Levix handles daily operations so you can focus on your customers.
feat1.title: Order Management
feat1.desc: Receive, track, and manage orders in real-time. Never miss a customer order with structured order tracking.
feat2.title: Inventory Tracking
feat2.desc: Keep track of your products, stock levels, and prices. Get alerts when items are running low.
feat3.title: WhatsApp Ordering
feat3.desc: Let customers browse your catalogue and place orders via WhatsApp. Simple and familiar for everyone.
feat4.title: Customer Management
feat4.desc: Build a customer database automatically. Track order history and contact details for better service.
feat5.title: Sales & Reports
feat5.desc: Understand your business with daily sales summaries, product performance, and simple analytics.
feat6.title: Team Access
feat6.desc: Add staff members with specific roles. Let your team manage orders and inventory with controlled permissions.
how.title: Up and Running in Minutes
how.sub: Getting started with Levix is straightforward. No technical setup required.
step1.title: Create Your Account
step1.desc: Sign up with your name, email, and shop details. It takes less than 2 minutes.
step2.title: Add Your Products
step2.desc: List your products with prices and stock quantities. Organise them by categories.
step3.title: Start Taking Orders
step3.desc: Share your shop link or connect WhatsApp. Customers order, you manage — all from your dashboard.
cta.title: Ready to organise your shop?
cta.sub: Set up your Levix account in minutes and start managing orders, stock, and customers from one place.
footer.desc: Simple, reliable shop management built for Indian businesses.
